# Copper-foil peer research leads

For Mitsui Kinzoku, investigate JX Advanced Metals (5016) as a core candidate: its low-profile surface treatments for high-speed applications cover rolled foil and FPC electrodeposited foil. Describe the difference from Mitsui's high-speed PCB electrodeposited foil and carrier-attached ultrathin foil. Investigate current listed ownership of Furukawa's foil operations and Asian high-speed electrodeposited foil suppliers when appropriate. Verify the business mix, listing, currency and availability of issuer forecast EPS. A product competitor may be private or a small part of a listed parent. A miner such as Sumitomo Metal Mining is a metals-cycle reference; keep it outside a foil-driven core median unless independently demonstrated product and earnings overlap warrants inclusion.

Start with the [Mitsui product range](https://em.mitsui-kinzoku.com/copper-foil/products/high-speed-copper-foil/), [JX surface treatments](https://www.jx-nmm.com/products/copper_foil_and_alloy/rolled_copper_foil/surface_treatment.html) and the [KGI product-by-product industry comparison, Figure 3](https://www.kgi.com.hk/zh-hk/-/media/files/kgishk/research-reports/tw-reports/pcb-sector_27082025.pdf). Recheck current ownership and guidance on each review.

For the November 2026 review, start directly with the [issuer presentation](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=q3r8oPU2SFw%3D&mid=1060&tabid=159), [new factory capacity timeline](https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/57060/140120261107568329.pdf), [interim results](https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/57060/140120261106567263.pdf), [JX quarterly filing](https://japanir.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/5016-20261109-03.pdf) and [JX market display](https://finance.matsui.co.jp/stock/5016/index). Verify which materials and closing prices are current as of the query date; later reviews must check for superseding disclosures. Extract the project total, asset components and disclosed commissioning dates for the fixed schedule. For dated Japanese close checks compare the explicit regular-session row on the broker snapshot with the daily history; distinguish intraday or PTS trades. Inspect the target at https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/5706/ and independent historical forecast P/E sources as well.
For recurring maintenance open the [25中計 cash-allocation slide, p.40](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=UUc%2B7P6vL4o%3D&mid=1060&tabid=159), open the [May 2026 revision, pp. 6–7](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=Qm2Jc2k%2Bpgo%3D&mid=1060&tabid=144) and check subsequent updates and distinguish the three-year actual from the plan. Use asset replacement lives for the new plant in addition to the old asset base. For copper foil profit, search Taiwan Co-Tech 金居 audited accounts for a direct electrolytic foil benchmark in addition to JX mixed ICT materials. Extract issuer product sales, dated peer operating profit and revenue, and the issuer’s relative profit targets. The fixed model determines the implied product range and the matching residual. Use the issuer’s comparable-segment EBIT table (実力損益推移・営業損益ベース) including business creation and consolidation. Keep management ROIC targets distinct from achieved incremental returns.
